description:
Perform a bone composition analysis on the loaded CT Cranium dataset. 

1. Create two segmentation masks using the standard InVesalius presets: one for 'Compact Bone (Adult)' and one for 'Spongial Bone (Adult)'. 
2. Generate 3D surfaces for both masks to determine their volumes. 
3. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/bone_report.txt' containing the volume of each (in mL) and the ratio of Compact to Spongial bone. Format: 
   Compact Bone Volume: [Value] mL
   Spongial Bone Volume: [Value] mL
   Ratio: [Value]
4. Save the InVesalius project to '/home/ga/Documents/bone_analysis.inv3'.

Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
